mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 64 degrees and clear at Verona Community Park, and we have a beautiful Waning Gibbous moon out there.
The city reminds residents that alternate-side winter parking starts November 20 to help with snow removal, and the Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.
There is plenty to do, including Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360 events, and Hop Haus trivia all happening today, plus Main Street Trick-Or-Treating taking place tomorrow.
In our weekly police report, on October 25, a 40-year-old Verona man was taken into custody for an O W I offence after being found stopped in an intersection.
Stop by Culver's while they are open until 10:00 PM to grab the delicious OREO REESE'S Cheesecake flavor of the day.
